eligibility.quote: waitForTransform throws a tf.Exception if one of the frames doesn't exist yet (which is actually the point of waitForTransform). It must be a bug in TF2.

failed_conditions.quote: When running inside rospy, the roscpp client is not initialized and thus ros::ok is false. I'm going to have to think about how to make this work cleanly in both roscpp and rospy. .

resolution.quote: do not short circuit waitForTransform timeout when running inside pytf. Fixes #102

notes: tf2_ros::Buffer::canTransform added ros::ok() condition which immediately aborted in rospy processes where roscpp is not initialized.
